buybackUpgradePrices.description: The price RSI asked for each different CCU buy-back when this build read it. A CCU is identified by the ship it upgrades from, the ship it upgrades to, and RSI's SKU of the upgrade, and its price is read once for all its buy-backs. A CCU buy-back has no page of its own; RSI prices it in its store upgrade page. These prices change, so a build never keeps one from an earlier build.

recordRemoval.description: Kept on a record RSI no longer lists when the Hangar Log does not account for its absence. It stays on the record if RSI lists it again.

buybackDetail.description: What a buy-back's page showed when it was read. The price is the price on that day; a discount is recorded as shown, without a cause. RSI shows the same page for every buy-back of the same item, so one page is read for an item: a detail with readFromBuybackId holds what the page of that other buy-back of the same item showed.

sourceUrl.description: The address of this buy-back's own page.

readFromBuybackId.description: Present when this buy-back's own page was not read: the number of the buy-back of the same item, the same title and contents line, whose page was read. capturedAt is when that page was read.

fromShipId.description: RSI's number of the ship the upgrade starts from.

toShipId.description: RSI's number of the ship the upgrade leads to.

toSkuId.description: RSI's number of the upgrade's SKU.

readFromBuybackId.description: The buy-back whose number was given to RSI when the price was read.

nativeAmount.description: The amount as RSI gave it, in cents of a US dollar, or null when RSI gave no price.

billingTotal.description: Direct TOTAL SPENT value observed on the RSI billing page; never replace it with a sum of order totals.

dateSortKey.description: Evidence-derived ISO 8601 calendar date used only for deterministic ordering; preserve dateRaw as the displayed source wording and use null when normalization is not proven.

removalComparison.description: Whether one list was compared with the earlier backup, and what the comparison found. No removal is claimed unless the status is compared.

contentHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme bytes after removing only integrity.contentHash and retaining integrity.algorithm; this detects document changes but is not an authenticity signature.
